description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of Git's upload-pack, particularly focusing on features like ref-in-want advertisement, handling of multiple refs, namespace ref handling, and simulating VFS server interactions for fetch operations.

methods.name: get_actual_refs
methods.description: Extracts refs from the output, filtering between 'wanted-refs' and '0001', and processes them into 'actual_refs'.

methods.name: get_actual_commits
methods.description: Processes the output to obtain commit hashes, sorts them into 'actual_commits'.

methods.name: check_output
methods.description: Runs the ref and commit extraction functions and compares output against expected results.

methods.name: write_command
methods.description: Outputs a command string, including object format if not sha1.

methods.name: write_fetch_command
methods.description: Constructs a fetch request, including want-ref, want, and have lines, suitable for testing the fetch negotiation.

methods.name: inconsistency
methods.description: Simulates repository state changes during negotiation to test server robustness against inconsistent refs.
